provenance.license: Retained manufacturer CAD and photographs retain their original rights; repository LICENSE is archived when present. Generated debug controls follow this repository license; source CAD is not relicensed.
provenance.sourcePolicy: Official CAD candidates are recorded independently in the model source audit; an uncalibrated model is not silently substituted for another SKU.

limitations: 采用固定版本官方 CAD；仅做刚体旋转和平移，不拉伸源几何。

Official T-LoRa-Pager printable enclosure parts 01–07, in their supplied relative coordinates. Antennas, PCB, LCD and keycaps are not reconstructed from these enclosure files. The Meshtastic listing uses the same reviewed Pager hardware; preloaded software does not change this CAD scope.
STL 不携带单位；按 mm 解读仅为预览约定，未完成实物测量或装配公差验证。
中性色材质用于调试，不表示已核实的实际材质和颜色。
实体屏幕窗口和按键位置未逐一校准；实时屏幕和语义按键由单独标记的调试面板提供。
官方照片仅作外观来源，不把照片中的演示内容作为实时固件画面。
标记 DEBUG INPUT 的按键是独立调试控件，不表示已核实的实物按键位置。
按官方正面照片选择观察方向：键盘在下、编码器在右；只旋转整组源几何。
